osmTags.inscription: In Loving Memory of Ann Doarn who was killed here on the 26th November 1978. Rest in Peace. Erected by her family.
Erected in memory of Terry Brett who died tragically at this spot on 2nd December 1978 aged 18 years. Always remembered by his loving family.

In Loving Memory Of / a beloved husband. father and grandfather / Owen McDonagh / Born in Ballyhaunis, Co. Mayo. / Lived in Shannon, Co. Clare. / Late of Glenmore and Ormonde Street. / who died tragically at this spot / 12th June 2009 aged 40 years /
Erected under corporation building scheme. John Magennis P.L.C. Mayor of Kilkenny 1914-15-16.

eras.label: Mapped site · auto T1
eras.summary: Mapped outline, terrain and present-day surroundings from open data. No historic reconstruction.
eras.basis: Everything drawn is traced from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL) and the Terrarium elevation tiles. Each element names its OSM way.
eras.conjecture: Walls and buildings without a sourced height are drawn as kerb-high plan lines, never as masses. Closed walls have no gates: none are mapped. The DEM is ~30 m source resolution: it cannot show terraces, ditches or scarps. Nothing historic is depicted.
